reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the well-known role of heterogeneous lattice distortions in HEAs (P10, P32) with the widely reported enhanced strain rate sensitivity (P3, P4, P5, P6, P7, P9, P13, P15, P22, P27, P29, P30, P34, P40, P47) into a single mechanistic framework that explicitly links distortions to uniform multiple slip system activation under dynamic loading, an integration not stated in any single passage. It further proposes a controlled comparison with a conventional ordered alloy to isolate the distortion effect, which goes beyond the individual studies that only compare within HEAs or to conventional metals without this specific mechanistic contrast.
